prompt: Work only in the supplied Henglish autopilot workspace. Read AGENTS.md and inspect the current branch, package scripts, TypeScript configuration, and build output. Choose one concrete build, type-safety, or runtime-integrity problem supported by code or a failing check; implement the smallest complete fix. Do not add dependencies, change deployment files, access .env files or secrets, alter database files or migrations, deploy, commit, push, or modify files outside the workspace. Run the narrowest relevant check and pnpm build. If there is no evidence-based fix, make no changes and explain why. Report evidence, files changed, checks, and risks.
